entries.name: Cape Kidnappers
entries.lint_flag: no-ticket: charges but has no ticketUrl

facts.claim: DOC manages the Cape Kidnappers/Te Kauwae-a-Maui Gannet Reserve; its page is the official site for the public-land walk and the colony.

The beach walk from Clifton can only be done around low tide; allow at least 5 hours return from Scotmans Point at Clifton, leaving no sooner than 3 hours after high tide and leaving the Cape no later than 1.5 hours after low tide; about 7 km of beach lies under cliffs with significant landslide and rockfall risk.
The best place to view nesting gannets is the Plateau colony on private land; a lower-risk way to reach it is a commercial overland tour through the private farm.
The track from the beach to the plateau colony is closed from July to the week before Labour Weekend each year; best viewing is early November to late February; nesting starts mid-September.

Gannet Safaris Overland regular tour (4x4 from Te Awanga) runs daily 1 Aug to 30 Apr at 9:00 am and 1:30 pm; adult (18+) $99, child (5-17) $49.50; the operator says it is the only tour that goes overland.
Napier i-SITE walking guide repeats the $99 adult overland tour price and the September-April season.

entries.hours: Tide-dependent walk; overland tours 9:00 AM and 1:30 PM daily (1 Aug - 30 Apr)
entries.cost_note: Adult overland tour $99 (Gannet Safaris Overland). The beach walk itself is free. Existing 75-100 is out of date.
entries.ticketUrl_note: Verified: DOC page titled 'Cape Kidnappers/Te Kauwae-a-Maui Gannet Reserve'. Cape Kidnappers is sold by more than one route (DOC walk free, tours by Gannet Safaris Overland https://gannetsafaris.co.nz/ - title 'Gannet Safaris Overland', verified), so the managing agency page is the one official site. entries.name: Hawke's Bay Trails

facts.claim: Official site hbtrails.nz ('Hawke's Bay Trails | New Zealand | OFFICIAL WEBSITE'), run by Hawke's Bay Regional Council: one of Ngā Haerenga's 23 Great Rides of New Zealand, wide, smooth, mostly flat limesand trails.
The site currently warns that major upgrades are underway across the trail network and some routes are temporarily affected; check the Trail Alerts page.
OSM information node 'Hawke's Bay Trails' at -39.60277, 176.87057 (trail info point near Clive/Chesterhope); the network spans Napier, Hastings and Havelock North.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Verified (title 'Hawke's Bay Trails ... OFFICIAL WEBSITE'). Note the old guess hawkesbaytrails.co.nz did not load.

coordinates_check.source: OSM information node n12101843571; a network has no single trailhead, this is a mapped trail information point

unverified: Visit time is a judgement.
Bike hire is separate (not priced here).

entries.name: Blackhead Beach

facts.claim: Central Hawke's Bay District Council: the southern gateway to Te Angiangi Marine Reserve (established 1997, 446 ha); fishing, swimming, rock pools, snorkelling; at low tide you can walk to Aramoana, about 6 km return; camping only at the Blackhead Beach Camping Ground, McHardy Place.
OSM maps a beach access point 'Vehicle access along beach at low tide' at -40.16701, 176.83605 on the shore, and the camping ground at -40.16754, 176.82768; the hamlet node is at -40.1686, 176.8247.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Verified: council page titled 'Blackhead Beach | Central Hawke's Bay District Council'.

coordinates_check.source: OSM tourism=attraction n1225262969 at the shore (the current point is the settlement, ~900 m inland)

entries.wiki_note: Wikipedia 'Blackhead, Hawke's Bay' is the settlement; no beach article.

entries.name: Aramoana Beach

facts.claim: Council: the northern access to Te Angiangi Marine Reserve; at low tide a broad mudstone platform shows rock pools; public toilets; diving, swimming, surfing, walking; 40-minute drive from Waipawa via Gibraltar Road (gravel, about 15 minutes); three marked spaces for self-contained motorhomes at the southern end of the public car park.
OSM: Ouepoto Beach Domain (leisure=nature_reserve) at -40.14189, 176.84445; Shoal Beach Road and the Shoal Beach camp site (-40.15083, 176.8461) are alongside.

entries.ticketUrl_note: Verified: council page titled 'Aramoana Beach | Central Hawke's Bay District Council'.

coordinates_check.source: OSM Ouepoto Beach Domain, the beach reserve (current point is inland, near the station buildings)

unverified: The public car park is not separately mapped; the domain point is the nearest mapped beach-side feature.
Placement bio mentions 'McHardy Homestead and rock pools': the council page mentions rock pools but not a homestead (McHardy Place is at Blackhead). Drop or source the homestead.

Mangakuri Beach page: Kairakau has public facilities and is an 11-minute drive from Mangakuri.
OSM: camp site way w385079789 on the beachfront at -39.94589, 176.92843; Kairakau Beach Road ends at -39.94428, 176.92881.

entries.name: Pourerere Beach

facts.claim: Council: kilometres of white sand with extensive rockpools, a busy boat-launching site and popular diving beach; 35-minute drive from Waipawa via Tamumu Road/Pourerere Road; campground at 232 Pourerere Beach Road; freedom camping (about 40 sites) needs a ballot permit 15 Dec to end of February.
OSM: Pourerere Domain (leisure=nature_reserve) at -40.11871, 176.8702 with camp sites at -40.1179, 176.8724.

entries.name: Te Paerahi Beach

facts.claim: Council: 50-minute drive from Waipawa, 45 minutes from Waipukurau via Porangahau Road; public toilets and water; surfcasting, swimming, surfing, walking (4 km to the river mouth); freedom camping next to the Recreation Reserve at Te Paerahi Road and Puketauhinu Place.
OSM: 'Porangahau Beach' (natural=sand, w351390756) runs about 6 km; public toilets at the Te Paerahi Road beach end, -40.30108, 176.66586.

entries.name: The Longest Place Name in the World

facts.claim: Wikipedia: a hill near Porangahau, south of Waipukurau, 305 m high, notable for its 85-character name; the longest place name in any English-speaking country and possibly the world, according to World Atlas and Guinness World Records. Lead coordinates -40.346, 176.5402.
Wikivoyage's Hawke's Bay page lists it under Central Hawke's Bay with its English translation.
OSM natural=peak node for the hill at -40.34606, 176.5403.
